paper: Zhang, Liu & Zhang (2012), arXiv:1211.0762, 'Spin-orbital Texture in Topological Insulators'

open_questions.question: What is the exact origin of the factor-2 prefactor gap in the total in-plane orbital spin magnitude, and does it disappear when the atom/orbital sum over alpha (the |Phi> expansion cross-terms) is retained rather than collapsed to a single effective orbital?
open_questions.why_heavy: Resolving it requires deriving the full multi-atom, multi-orbital surface-state expansion of the Bi2Se3 slab from first principles (the alpha-sum the paper carries implicitly), tracking every cross-term and Pauli-vs-spin (1/2) convention through D^pm_{i,eta}. This is a genuine analytic re-derivation, not a parameter tweak, and it is the one place our replication differs from the paper.
open_questions.compute_needed: analytic (pen-and-paper + sympy verification); no HPC. ~1 day of careful k.p algebra.

open_questions.question: Does an independent ab-initio (DFT+SOC) calculation of a Bi2Se3 slab reproduce the same p-orbital-resolved spin-orbital texture (p_z helical, p_x/p_y 2-theta, tangential-upper/radial-lower) that the effective k.p model predicts, and do the fitted u0,v0,u1,v1,w1 come out with the signs the texture requires?
open_questions.why_heavy: This is the paper's second pillar (they claim BOTH k.p AND ab-initio). Reproducing it means a converged VASP/QE slab with SOC, surface-state identification, and orbital+spin projection of the surface bands onto p_x/p_y/p_z around the Fermi contour -- a full DFT surface-state workflow, not a model build.
open_questions.compute_needed: uicgpu A100 or ALCF: DFT+SOC slab (>=6 quintuple layers), Wannier/orbital projection. ~2-3 days incl. convergence.

open_questions.question: What spin-resolved, photon-polarization-dependent ARPES intensity would actually be measured for P_{p_x}, once dipole matrix elements and photon-energy/geometry dependence are folded in on top of the bare Eq.10 polarization?
open_questions.why_heavy: The paper proposes the experiment but gives the bare orbital polarization; a falsifiable prediction requires a one-step photoemission / dipole-matrix-element model (final-state effects, light polarization vectors, experimental geometry) layered on the surface wavefunctions. That is a separate photoemission-theory calculation.
open_questions.compute_needed: analytic + small numeric (dipole matrix elements over the contour); modest CPU. ~2-3 days.

open_questions.question: How does the spin-orbital texture evolve when a hexagonal-warping (Fu C3v k^3) term is ADDED to Eq.1 -- i.e., bridging arXiv:1211.0762 (isotropic) to the warped-Dirac model of the sibling paper the task framing conflated it with?
open_questions.why_heavy: This is genuinely new physics beyond the paper: the warping term mixes the orbital sublattices with 3-theta angular structure, so the clean 2-theta orbital-character modulation and the [sin,cos] textures would acquire higher harmonics. Building it cleanly means extending the 6-dim basis Hamiltonian with the k^3 sigma_z warping and re-deriving D^pm -- a real model extension, and the natural next paper.
open_questions.compute_needed: model-Hamiltonian rebuild (extend zhang2012_replicate.py with the warping term); local CPU. ~1-2 days.

open_questions.question: Is the right-handed net in-plane orbital spin for BOTH Dirac cones (the paper's headline qualitative surprise) robust to the parameter set, or does it require a specific sign/magnitude ordering of u1 vs w1 -- and where in (u1,w1) space does the tangential-dominant vs radial-dominant character invert?
open_questions.why_heavy: Turning a single-parameter-set confirmation into a phase-diagram claim requires mapping the sign of the dominance coefficient (v0 -/+ k*u1)*k*w1 and the P_{p_x} zero-crossing across the physically allowed (u0,v0,u1,v1,w1) manifold, ideally constrained by the DFT fit of Q2. It elevates 'it works for our numbers' to 'here is the regime where the claim holds.'
open_questions.compute_needed: parameter sweep over the model (cheap); local CPU. Best done jointly with Q2's DFT-constrained parameters. ~1 day.

next_steps: Retain the alpha atom/orbital sum in |Phi_pm> and re-derive the total in-plane spin prefactor symbolically (sympy) to close the factor-2 gap (Q1).
Run a Bi2Se3 DFT+SOC slab on uicgpu, project surface bands onto p_x/p_y/p_z x spin, and fit u0..w1 to compare against the k.p texture (Q2, feeds Q5).
Layer a dipole-matrix-element photoemission model on the surface wavefunctions to turn Eq.10 into a measurable spin-ARPES intensity prediction (Q3).
Extend zhang2012_replicate.py with a Fu k^3 hexagonal-warping term and map the emergence of 3-theta harmonics in the spin-orbital texture (Q4).
Sweep the (u1,w1) parameter plane to map the tangential/radial dominance inversion and the P_{p_x} sign-flip locus (Q5).
